item.tib: man ngag bar do gcig chod
item.coloph: man ngag rgyal po gser gyi gdams pa 'di/ rje kun tu bzang po (pos) 'og min d+ha (bde) ba can gyi gnas su dran pa nam mkha' la gsungs/ dran pa nam mkha'i (mkhas) khyung lung dngul mkhar du/ sras tshe dbang rig 'dzin la gsungs/ tshe dbang rig 'dzin bya ri gtsug ldan du/ gshen gsas lha rje la gsungs/ sprul sku gshen gsas lha rje'i drung du rtogs ldan shes rab dpal gyis zhus/ de la gshen rab bdag gis zhus/ de nas dad ldan mos gus can gyi sgo nas/ bdag tshe dbang rgyal mtshan gyis zhus/ drin can pha ma'i gtsor byas nam mkha' dang mnyams (mnyam) pa'i khams gsum sems can thams cad kyis (kyi) don du bsngo/ dge'o// bkra shis//
